title: Battle.net app data
whyItMatters: The Battle.net desktop app keeps account sign-in state and cached game data in this folder. It shows which Blizzard account was used on this Mac.
source: Blizzard Support, Deleting the Battle.net cache folder: the macOS folder is ~/Library/Application Support/Battle.net - https://us.battle.net/support/en/article/34721
notes: Installed Blizzard games live in /Applications and are covered by the installed programs rules. Cache contents are not read.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Battle.net app, then remove this device from the account's authorized devices on the Blizzard website.
steps: Sign out of the Battle.net app.
Uninstall the app by moving it to the Trash.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes the app sign-in state and cached data from this Mac. Games and licences stay with the Blizzard account.
cleanup.source: Blizzard Support, Deleting the Battle.net Cache Folder: https://us.battle.net/support/en/article/34721
